transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um, the main reason I came in is that I just get pulled off track so easily. I'll be working on something, and... well, one Slack ping, or even just a song lyric, or a random idea for another project pops into my head, and suddenly I’ve completely lost the thread of the dashboard I was actually supposed to be finishing. It just happens a lot, and I wanted to talk to someone about it.
Did you experience these kinds of attention and focus difficulties when you were a child?

Yeah, I did. Um, even back in elementary school, my teachers would write comments on my report cards about me rushing through worksheets, or just... losing track of the directions. I also talked over my classmates a lot during group work. And at home, my parents actually had to sit right beside me while I did my homework. If they didn't, I would just wander off or start doing something completely different before I finished it.
Do you often feel physically restless or find yourself constantly fidgeting and having trouble sitting still?

Yeah, I do. Um, especially in meetings or during portfolio reviews for my classes. I'm almost always bouncing my leg, or clicking my pen, or twisting my rings around. I just shift around in my chair a lot, too. Honestly, I don't really even notice I'm doing it until someone looks over at me, and then I realize I've been moving the whole time.
